scope: read-only scratch discriminators on REAL_LOCAL_HOST_AI_CORE_NODE_NOT_SANDBOXED; no live avatar source mutation; no promotion to live/WebGL/product credit

observations.name: isolated_amd_hardware_sourceover
observations.interpretation: The raw AMD/ANGLE source-over blend path is not sufficient to explain the large final screenshot mismatch.

observations.name: single_variable_y_orientation_repair
observations.change_only: vertex shader uv=vec2(p.x,1.-p.y) -> uv=p while UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL remains enabled
observations.causal_conclusion: The double Y-flip/orientation contradiction is a real causal defect in the screenshot gate/harness, responsible for roughly half of the observed mismatch by these metrics. It is not the complete cause.

observations.name: production_geometry_sampling_discriminator
observations.causal_conclusion: Reducing the original extreme 120x80 gate to production-like 620x414 does not collapse the residual. This rules out the extreme downscale factor as the sole cause, but does not yet rule out a persistent DOM-vs-Canvas/WebGL resampling-path difference because 1536x1024 is still resampled at 620x414.

observations.name: premultiply_and_canvas2d_discriminator
observations.causal_conclusion: Canvas2D and both WebGL alpha/premultiply variants are pixel-identical in this discriminator, while all retain the same residual against DOM. Therefore WebGL premultiplication and the manual GPU source-over path are not the remaining cause. The residual is isolated upstream/downstream to DOM image rendering/compositing semantics versus the Canvas/WebGL raster path.

coordination.reason: A parallel worker closed the same sampling boundary first with a stronger production-geometry discriminator; duplicate execution was removed before opening further breadth.

remaining_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: DOM raster/resampling at scaled geometry differs from Canvas2D/WebGL texture rasterization. 620x414 is still a 1536x1024 downsample, so the earlier geometry test did not eliminate this class.
remaining_hypotheses_ranked.discriminator: Run one representative pair at native 1536x1024 1:1 geometry with the Y fix. If DOM-vs-Canvas/WebGL mismatch collapses, isolate DOM scaling/filtering as root cause.

remaining_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: CSS opacity/compositor color-space semantics differ from Canvas2D/WebGL even without resampling.
remaining_hypotheses_ranked.discriminator: If native 1:1 geometry still differs, compare single opaque source, then one translucent source over #111, then two-layer opacity crossfade to separate image decode/raster from CSS opacity/compositor color-space behavior.

remaining_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Pixel registration/backing-store geometry differs between DOM and canvas paths.
remaining_hypotheses_ranked.discriminator: If single opaque native-size DOM-vs-canvas still differs, estimate translation/registration and compare exact crop bounds before any blend.

next_exact_action: Run a native-resolution 1536x1024 one-pair DOM-vs-Canvas/WebGL read-only discriminator. Do not patch the live body renderer until DOM raster/resampling is separated from CSS opacity/compositor semantics.
